cases.name: testDetachFromOperators
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    lv_any =`abc` &&`def`.
    lv_any ='abc' &&'def'.
    lv_any =:`abc`,`def`.
    lv_any =:'abc','def'.

    lv_any =`abc`"comment
          &&`def`.
    lv_any ='abc'"comment
          &&'def'.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    lv_any = `abc` && `def`.
    lv_any = 'abc' && 'def'.
    lv_any =: `abc`, `def`.
    lv_any =: 'abc', 'def'.

    lv_any = `abc` "comment
          && `def`.
    lv_any = 'abc' "comment
          && 'def'.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testDynamicMethodCallUnchanged
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    CALL METHOD ('METHOD_NAME').
    CALL METHOD lo_instance->('METHOD_NAME').
    CALL METHOD ('CLASS_NAME')=>('METHOD_NAME').

    CALL METHOD (`METHOD_NAME`).
    CALL METHOD lo_instance->(`METHOD_NAME`).
    CALL METHOD (`CLASS_NAME`)=>(`METHOD_NAME`).

    ASSIGN ('(FUNC_GRP_NAME)TABLE[]') TO <lt_table>.

    ls_struc-('COMPONENT_NAME') = 1.
    <ls_struc>-('COMPONENT_NAME') = 1.
    lt_table[ 1 ]-('COMPONENT_NAME') = 1.
    lr_data_ref->('COMPONENT_NAME') = 1.

    ls_struc-(`COMPONENT_NAME`) = 1.
    <ls_struc>-(`COMPONENT_NAME`) = 1.
    lt_table[ 1 ]-(`COMPONENT_NAME`) = 1.
    lr_data_ref->(`COMPONENT_NAME`) = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    CALL METHOD ('METHOD_NAME').
    CALL METHOD lo_instance->('METHOD_NAME').
    CALL METHOD ('CLASS_NAME')=>('METHOD_NAME').

    CALL METHOD (`METHOD_NAME`).
    CALL METHOD lo_instance->(`METHOD_NAME`).
    CALL METHOD (`CLASS_NAME`)=>(`METHOD_NAME`).

    ASSIGN ('(FUNC_GRP_NAME)TABLE[]') TO <lt_table>.

    ls_struc-('COMPONENT_NAME') = 1.
    <ls_struc>-('COMPONENT_NAME') = 1.
    lt_table[ 1 ]-('COMPONENT_NAME') = 1.
    lr_data_ref->('COMPONENT_NAME') = 1.

    ls_struc-(`COMPONENT_NAME`) = 1.
    <ls_struc>-(`COMPONENT_NAME`) = 1.
    lt_table[ 1 ]-(`COMPONENT_NAME`) = 1.
    lr_data_ref->(`COMPONENT_NAME`) = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
